{"id":1986432366,"question_id":2721,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1776969091,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1986432366/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of Distances","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long; \n    vector<long long> distance(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_map<ll , vector<ll>>mp;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++) mp[nums[i]].push_back(i);\n\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            cout<<it.first<<\"->\";\n            for(auto x : it.second) cout<<x<<\",\";\n            cout<<endl;\n        }\n\n        vector<long long>ans(nums.size() , 0);\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(it.second.size() == 1) continue;\n\n            for(int i = 0 ; i<it.second.size() ; i++)\n            {\n                int dist = 0;\n                for(int j = 0 ; j<it.second.size() ; j++)\n                {\n                    if(i == j) continue;\n                    dist += abs(it.second[i] - it.second[j]);\n                }\n                ans[it.second[i]] = dist;\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-distances","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1933}
